headline: Chesapeake Indenture · Jordan & Walsh 2008

items.title: White Cargo (2008) Audit
items.detail: 150 years of British colonial servant transportation documented by Jordan and Walsh.

items.title: European Servants Shipped
items.detail: 500,000 maximum estimate (300,000–500,000 English, Scottish, and Irish servants).

items.title: Chesapeake Term Mortality
items.detail: 40% died before completing indenture terms (up to 30% voyage mortality).

items.title: London Child Abductions
items.detail: 840 children kidnapped from British streets in one year by spirit-merchant William Thiene.

items.title: Elizabeth Abbott Case
items.detail: 500 lashes inflicted in fatal beating while planter court shielded the master.

items.title: First 5,000 Land Survival
items.detail: 241 servants out of 5,000 survived indenture to acquire colonial land (4.8%).

sources: Jordan & Walsh (2008), White Cargo; The Original Power, Ch. 4
